description: A front-facing goblin head with a narrow bald oval skull, long pointed ears spreading out sideways, and two heavy slanted brows over the eyes, symmetric about its vertical axis.
The lowercase letters gog stacked above com in heavy rounded geometric type, both lines of equal width, with no frame.
A mushroom-shaped enemy from the front: a broad cap with jagged angry brows and upright oval eyes, a flat grimacing mouth line, a narrow stalk body and two flat feet on the ground.
An upright egg-shaped handheld toy with a rounded square screen centred inside, set slightly above the middle of the egg.
A man's bust from the front: swept-back hair with a widow's peak, dark rectangular sunglasses, a goatee and moustache, a neck and broad sloping shoulders.

description: An empty horizontal burst-shaped speech bubble with a wavy spiked outline, surrounded by short straight action lines radiating outward from above, below and the corners.
A frog head from the front with two large bulging round eyes on top, a wide open mouth spanning the face, and a pointed petal collar zigzagging around the neck.
A round frog-like alien face framed by a close-fitting hood that hangs down on both sides, with two large round eyes and a wide downturned mouth curve.
A key lying horizontally: a large round bow on the left with a small hole, a straight shaft running right, and a stepped bit with two notches ending in an angled tip.
An upright key: a round ring bow with a dot at the top, a long straight shaft, and two short teeth projecting to the right near the bottom.
A puffy cloud with scalloped lobes all around its outline and a single large eye, a ring around a solid pupil, at its centre.
A round-bodied creature from the front with two pointed horns at the top corners and two pointed feet at the bottom, two tall oval eyes and a wide open smiling mouth.
A diagonal rounded bar running from upper-left to lower-right, with a small ring in the upper-right corner and a small solid circle in the lower-left, each in the space beside the bar.
A single spiral line winding inward about three turns from an outer circle to a small hooked centre, its open end trailing off at the bottom.
A bold outlined capital letter L: a tall vertical stem with a short foot running right along the bottom, drawn as a single closed outline with square corners.
